description: This file is a TypeScript-based script for analyzing and detecting architecture smells in a TypeScript project. It imports various utility modules to scan source files, identify specific code patterns, and generate reports on architecture issues such as plugin SDK extension facade problems, runtime type implementation issues, and service locator patterns.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Compares two inventory entries to determine their order based on category, file, line, kind, specifier, and reason.

methods.name: pushEntry
methods.description: Adds an entry to the list of smell entries.

methods.name: scanPluginSdkExtensionFacadeSmells
methods.description: Detects architecture smells related to plugin SDK extension facades by analyzing module specifiers and re-exports.

methods.name: scanRuntimeTypeImplementationSmells
methods.description: Identifies problematic direct references to runtime implementation shim files via import type nodes.

methods.name: scanRuntimeServiceLocatorSmells
methods.description: Detects use of service locator patterns and mutable global state in runtime-related source files.

methods.name: collectArchitectureSmells
methods.description: Collects and returns all detected architecture smells across the project.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats the collection of architecture smell entries into a human-readable string.

methods.name: runArchitectureSmellsCheck
methods.description: Runs the architecture smells scan and outputs results in JSON or human-readable format based on arguments.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the script, invoking the architecture smells check.
